facts.text: Meet me at the Frosty Palace after the dance. Bring the girls, Sandy.
facts.why: Danny and Sandy meet at the Frosty Palace before the dance, when she is out with Tom and he tries to make up. After the dance Sandy storms off. Nobody asks her to bring the girls.
facts.fix: Meet me at the Frosty Palace, Sandy. I'll buy the fries and try not to act tough.

facts.text: Frenchy's booth, right before Teen Angel shows up.
facts.why: Wikipedia has Frenchy's angel scene after her beauty school disaster, staged as the Beauty School Dropout number, not in a Frosty Palace booth. Frenchy's pink hair is in the plot but nothing ties her to a tuna melt.
facts.fix: A Frosty Palace booth, Pink Ladies style.
